title: Sample Congregation Heritage Journey
subtitle: A SAMPLE group itinerary through Jewish Curaçao — for demonstration only
price_note: Final per-person pricing depends on group size and will be confirmed with your congregation.
intro:
This is a SAMPLE page built to show Sample Congregation and Rabbi Sample what a private group journey to Curaçao could look like.

Every detail below — dates, itinerary, pricing note — is a placeholder for demonstration and will be tailored to your congregation before anything is finalized.
included:
Private guided touring each day
All accommodations (double occupancy)
Daily breakfast and welcome Shabbat dinner
Airport transfers in Curaçao
Entrance fees to all sites listed in the itinerary
not_included:
International airfare to Curaçao
Lunches and dinners not otherwise noted
Travel insurance
Gratuities for guides and drivers

itinerary.title: Arrival & Welcome
itinerary.text: Arrive in Willemstad, settle in, and gather for a welcome dinner overlooking St. Anna Bay.

itinerary.title: The Snoa & Old City
itinerary.text: Visit the historic sand-floor synagogue Mikvé Israel-Emanuel and walk the UNESCO old town of Willemstad.

itinerary.title: Beth Haim Cemetery
itinerary.text: Tour one of the oldest Jewish cemeteries in the Americas and learn the stories behind its inscriptions.

itinerary.title: Community & Culture
itinerary.text: Meet local community members and academics for a people-to-people exchange on Curaçao's Jewish history.

itinerary.title: Coast & Free Time
itinerary.text: A day at leisure to explore Curaçao's coastline, beaches, and markets before Shabbat.

form_intro: If your congregation is interested in a journey like this one, let us know and we will follow up to plan the details together.
notify_note: You will be contacted once the program and booking details are finalized.
